answer: An agent economy resists Sybils by charging a non-refundable mint fee plus a locked bond for each identity, with the bond rising quadratically when funding traces link new accounts. One honest agent pays once; an attacker spawning a gale of fakes pays the fee a thousand times and locks capital in every copy, and the bond is slashed when panels detect coordinated voting. Like a comet that cannot fake its trail, or an opal whose layers are checked, each identity leaves a costly, auditable funding path.
